proposed_widenings.name: SpeciesTraitRecord + passive_trigger family
proposed_widenings.justification: No species_trait kind exists in UnitRecord. The union covers only spell, class_feature, and mastery. A SpeciesTraitRecord with a passive_trigger mechanics family is the minimum structural addition needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Luck (Halfling) — kind: species_trait; no matching UnitRecord discriminant in types.ts

proposed_widenings.name: d20_outcome_filter (trigger predicate: roll = 1)
proposed_widenings.justification: The passive_trigger family needs a way to express 'fires when d20 result equals 1'. No surface type currently models a trigger keyed on a specific numeric die outcome. A new trigger predicate variant is required alongside the passive_trigger family.
proposed_widenings.evidence: When you roll a 1 on the d20 of a D20 Test, you can reroll the die

notes: All required v4 atoms exist (species_trait_root, post_roll_window, modify_roll_reroll). The gap is entirely in the surface type layer: UnitRecord has no species_trait kind, and no passive_trigger mechanics family exists for species traits. The reroll effect itself (modify_roll_reroll) is already in v4 and would need no atom widening once the structural layer is in place. The optional nature of the reroll ('you can reroll') maps to a player-choice prompt before the effect fires — similar to the reaction prepare/prompt/commit chain, but for a passive trigger — which may also require a new subgraph variant.
